en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the limit of the handshake. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Going round a palm tree’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim who has said the following: “Once I asked abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) ‘How often is this handshake?’
The Imam said, ‘It is just after going around a palm tree.’”
